description: I don’t go against me. I’ve worked too hard to get here. #selflove #accountability #selfpreservation
transcript: Nothing about me is a secret to myself. I know who I am from the top of my head to the bottom of my feet. I know how I will respond to things. I can smell an environment before I walk through the door and know immediately if I want to occupy that space or not, not play games with myself. I'm very, very, very particular about the life that I live because I worked hard to build the structure to build resilience, to build a relationship, and I will not go against myself in order to please the external world.
